narration: Pretoria, South Africa, 1971. A quiet, bookish boy is born.

characters.action: holds a thick book against chest, blinks

props: small white book stack, bottom left
white chalk-style sun doodle, top right

narration: Small, bookish, and a favorite target for school bullies.

characters.action: hugs book, shoulders hunched, backs away
points one stick arm at kid, other fist raised

props: school wall with plain rectangle windows, background
fallen book on ground, center

narration: So he buried himself in a computer manual and taught himself to code.

characters.action: sits at desk, one arm holds open manual, other types

props: CRT computer on desk, right, green text lines on screen
huge open manual book on desk, center
desk lamp with yellow glow circle, left
crescent moon in window, top left

narration: Twelve. Self-taught. Already selling. His space shooter: Blastar.
props: CRT computer, right, screen shows tiny triangle spaceship shooting dots
handwritten sign on wall 'BLASTAR', top center
floppy disk (black square with white label), center

narration: A magazine bought the code. Price: five hundred dollars.

characters.action: holds up envelope, other hand on forehead

props: white envelope with green '$500' handwritten, center, pops in
magazine (rectangle with scribbled title 'PC & OFFICE TECHNOLOGY'), editor desk, right
floppy disk in editor's hand

on_screen_text.speaker: editor
on_screen_text.text: Editor: Who is this programmer? Elon: A twelve-year-old. Cash, please.

narration: At seventeen, he left home alone for Canada. One suitcase.

characters.action: walks right carrying suitcase, other arm swings

props: brown rectangle suitcase with handle, in hand
giant triangle mountains, background, dwarfing him
orange sun semicircle on horizon, center
handwritten arrow sign 'CANADA' pointing right, right

narration: 1995: Stanford PhD begins. Two days later, he quit to build Zip2.

characters.action: sprints away carrying a rolled paper, one arm pumping

props: calendar pages 'DAY 1' and 'DAY 2' flying off wall, left, metaphor of time ripped away
big rolled diploma scroll labeled 'PhD' dropped on ground, center
plain building with sign 'Stanford' in handwriting, background left

narration: With brother Kimbal, he built city guides. They slept in the office.

characters.action: types on computer, eyes half closed
lies on sleeping bag, one arm holds towel

props: CRT computer on desk, left, map of squares and a pin on screen
sleeping bag rectangles on floor, right
towel and soap bar, right, with handwritten sign 'YMCA SHOWERS'
handwritten sign 'Zip2' taped to window, top center

narration: Compaq paid three hundred seven million. Elon's share: twenty-two million, at twenty-seven.

characters.action: holds big money bag up with both arms

props: brown money bag with handwritten '$' overhead, center, pops in
oversized white check with handwritten 'Compaq - $307,000,000', right
green bills (rectangles) raining down
